name: Localization Delivery
query:
select
	te.locale as "Locale:Link/Locale Profile:90",
	te.app as "App::140",
	coalesce(nullif(te.delivery_status, ''), 'Not Verified') as "Delivery::110",
	count(*) as "Strings:Int:80",
	min(te.source_text) as "Example::300"
from `tabTranslation Entry` te
where te.status in ('Approved', 'Reviewed')
	and te.translated_text is not null and te.translated_text != ''
group by te.locale, te.app, te.delivery_status
order by
	field(coalesce(nullif(te.delivery_status, ''), 'Not Verified'),
		'Not Deployed', 'Overridden', 'Cache Stale', 'Not Verified', 'Live'),
	te.locale asc, te.app asc
